lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns, creating a semi-rectilinear grid along the mid-lateral flank. Centroid spacing is approximately uniform across the visible posterior section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming defined grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, transitioning from a high-intensity illuminated upper edge to a low-intensity shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Four discrete high-luminance circular blobs are visible, primarily clustered in the lower posterior quadrant of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The apex and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin exhibit irregular edge topography with significant notches and missing tissue segments, indicating mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Intense high-frequency light refractive patterns (caustics) from the water's surface create non-biological luminance fluctuations across the anterior portion of the visible specimen.
